name: Remove board label during setup
description: ## Summary: Remove the Label field from Data Root setup. The TUI New Data Root form (startup picker / Data Root switcher "+ New Data Root", src/tui/screens/setup/InitForm.tsx) asks for a Label first, which reads like a second Board name. It is actually the optional Data Root label in ~/.rowblyrc.json (dataRoots[].label), used only by the header button and the Data Root switcher. Setup should not ask for it. ## Scope: (1) InitForm.tsx: remove the label field and the intro sentence "The label names it in ~/.rowblyrc.json..." (keep the --data-root/default explanation if still useful); stop passing label to createDataRoot. (2) CLI rowbly init: stop prompting for the label in an interactive terminal (askLabel in src/commands/setup/util.ts, called from src/commands/setup/command.ts:109); keep the --label <label> flag so scripts can still name it. (3) docs/user-guide.md: line ~149 (init no longer asks for the label) and lines ~171-172 (TUI setup no longer asks for the label). ## Out of scope: --label flag on init; e (edit label/default) in the Data Root switcher (EditDataRootModal); the optional Label in global onboarding Register an existing Data Root; the dataRoots schema. ## Behavior: a Data Root created through setup gets no label, so the header and switcher show the folder holding .rowbly (or Global for ~/.rowbly) per dataRootName; the label can still be set later with e in the switcher. ## Acceptance: the New Data Root form shows Default Data Root, Board name, Board id, Key prefix and Your handle (Me) only; interactive rowbly init asks no label question; rowbly init --label Work still records the label; typecheck, lint, test:unit and test:cli pass. No new test needed (AGENTS.md: form/prompt changes add no test).
